build_palette_image: build a PIL P-mode image with the NES pixel-art palette for Image.quantize()
list_available_palettes: list all available named pixel-art palettes including NES, PICO_8, and NEON_CYBER
retrieve_palette_colors: retrieve the RGB color tuples for the GAMEBOY_ORIGINAL pixel-art palette
validate_palette_name: validate that a given palette name exists in the PALETTES dictionary
compare_hardware_palettes: compare the color counts between hardware palettes like ZX_SPECTRUM and C64
